newsitem.title: USA: Capital One sees Q2 flat vs year ago.
newsitem.headline: Capital One sees Q2 flat vs year ago.

text.p: Capital One Financial Corp expects its second quarter earnings to be flat compared to last year's second quarter earnings of $0.57 a share, a spokeswoman for the company said.
On a consensus basis, analysts had expected Capital One to post second quarter earnings of $0.66 a share, according to First Call.
Capital One, which issues Visa and MasterCard credit cards in the United States, dropped 3-1/2 points to 36-3/8 in afternoon trading.

"Our portfolio is showing positive signs. Deliquencies were flat, but charge offs were as expected. But since deliquencies were flat, there was lower fee income and lower charging," said Capital One spokeswoman Diana Sun.
Falls Church, Va.-based Capital One first disclosed the earnings forecast in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday.
Capital One said it expects to release its second quarter earnings on or about July 17.
